meta.name: counterexample-debugger
meta.description: Debug proof failures using counterexamples from Nitpick (Isabelle) or QuickChick (Coq) to identify specification errors, missing preconditions, and proof strategy issues. Use when: (1) A proof attempt fails and you need to understand why, (2) Counterexamples are generated by Nitpick or QuickChick, (3) Specifications may be incorrect or incomplete, (4) Theorems need validation before proving, (5) Missing preconditions or lemmas need identification, or (6) Proof failures need explanation and correction suggestions. Supports both Isabelle/HOL and Coq equally.

copy.tagline: 用反例定位证明失败的根本原因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 Isabelle/HOL 或 Coq 做形式化证明时遇到失败。
